# Palette fixtures

Real theme files, unmodified, for the palette parsers. They prove the converters against what people actually download; nothing here is bundled into `main.js`. Sources, read 2026-09-05:

- `one-dark.js`: `@codemirror/theme-one-dark` 6.1.3, `dist/index.js`. MIT, Copyright (C) 2018-2021 by Marijn Haverbeke and others. https://github.com/codemirror/theme-one-dark
- `dracula.js`: `thememirror` 2.0.1, `dist/themes/dracula.js`. MIT, Vadim Demedes. https://github.com/vadimdemedes/thememirror
- `github.js`: `@uiw/codemirror-theme-github` 4.25.11, `esm/index.js` (a light and a dark theme in one module). MIT, uiw. https://github.com/uiwjs/react-codemirror
- `Obsidian.xml`: Notepad++ theme `Obsidian.xml` from a Notepad++ 8.7 install (`themes\Obsidian.xml`). GPL-3.0, Notepad++ contributors. https://github.com/notepad-plus-plus/notepad-plus-plus

The names above are also in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
